description.value: Gus' Bar and Grill is a family-owned waterfront pub in Port McNeill on northern Vancouver Island, founded in 1997 by the late Gus Baroutis and now run by his son Tasos. Perched right on the waterfront with an outdoor deck, it offers what the owners describe as a 'million dollar' oceanview alongside pub food, cold beer on tap, pool, and keno. It bills itself as the North Island's premium tap house and draws locals and visitors alike for sports viewing and daily food and drink specials.
